meta.title: Your dashboard · Mapsly
meta.description: Weekly check-in on how your business is doing online.

dashboard.title: What's happening with {name}
dashboard.empty_body: We don't have a business linked to your account yet. We'll show you what's working, what's not, and what to fix — once you tell us where you are.
dashboard.kpi_mapsly_score_tip: A weekly score from 0 to 10 across 6 things: reputation, replies, profile, trust, pricing, and brand. Higher means healthier.
dashboard.kpi_no_data_sublabel: We'll show this once your first refresh runs
dashboard.kpi_rating_tip: Your average star rating on Google. Anything below 4.5 typically shows on the third page of search.
dashboard.kpi_reviews_tip: How many reviews you have on Google. More reviews builds trust with people picking between you and a competitor.
dashboard.kpi_reply_rate_tip: How often you reply to reviews. Most businesses in your category reply to about 89%.
dashboard.kpi_rank_tip: Where you stand among other businesses in your category and city. Lower numbers are better.
dashboard.kpi_velocity_tip: How many new reviews came in over the last 30 days. Steady flow keeps you visible.
dashboard.breakdown_heading: Where you're strong, where you're not
dashboard.breakdown_no_data_caption: We'll fill this in after your first refresh.
dashboard.dim_reputation_tip: Your star rating, how many reviews you have, and how often new ones come in.
dashboard.dim_communication_tip: How often and how quickly you respond to reviews.
dashboard.dim_profile_tip: How complete your Google listing is — hours, phone, photos, services.
dashboard.dim_trust_tip: Whether your listing is claimed, how long you've been around, and other trust signals.
dashboard.dim_pricing_tip: Whether people can see what you charge before they call.
dashboard.dim_brand_tip: Your website health, ads, social, and how well Google can read your site.
dashboard.fixes_empty_body: We'll show you the highest-impact things to fix here once your first weekly refresh runs.
